container-storage-v2-no-fee.title: Version 2 of Azure Container Storage has no service fee
container-storage-v2-no-fee.body: This estimate charges the version 1 orchestration fee on pool capacity above 5 TiB. Version 2.x adds no service or orchestration fee; only the backing storage is billed. Check whether version 2 fits your workload.

citation.quote: Azure Container Storage doesn’t add any service or orchestration fees. You only pay for the underlying storage you choose.
